title: Attach full province names
prompt: Return each patient's first_name, last_name, and full province_name by joining patients with provinces.
starterSql:
SELECT
  -- patient names and province name
FROM patients AS p
JOIN provinces AS pr
  ON -- matching keys;
referenceSql:
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, pr.province_name
FROM patients AS p
JOIN provinces AS pr
  ON pr.province_id = p.province_id;
explanation: The join replaces the abbreviated foreign key with its descriptive province name.
